entry.text: |Technology used in |Java, JSP, Spring MVC and Hibernate,Log4j,Maven.     |
Google play protect is web based project to book or reserve rooms
through online.  Here basically two modules is there.  One is user can
reserve room and other one is Service Provider.
Functionality where user can select room of his choice.  Based
on category like Single room, double room and triple room.  Once user
selects category type, it shows all rooms available on that date.  Once
user reserve room on particular date, then will send confirmation email to
User can also see reservations on history tab; also cancel
The service provider can view who has registered rooms and he/she can
view basic info from the user which has entered during the registration
Service provider can have a view on total number of reservations
booked, number of reservations still available. In case of any change in
reservation, he must send a notification to the customer about the change.
It is possible for service provider to make any reservations of his own
service manually. The service provider has an option to view users by black
/ white list as well as add users to black/white list.
• Involved in implementing the creation of Badges using Spring
• Client side validations using validation framework.
• Involved in developing user module in this project.
• Using Subversion as version control for pushing the code and pulling
• Preparing and sending report for the development work on daily basis.
